messages:
noah: quick thread to lock scope for the visibility console MVP. key surfaces: cost-by-route (estimates ok), error grouping, trace links (no flamegraphs), and a tiny alerts panel. need launch gates and owners.
irene: from design: keep UI single-pane with tabs. show an "estimate" badge when numbers are heuristic. short explainer modal for customers.
david: infra note: prefer conservative retention to start. propose 48h raw traces + 30d aggregated rollups. cost impact ~+9% monthly. need finance OK.
priya: CS feedback from pilots: must have per-model-version error breakdown and ability to jump to request id. they'll accept estimated cost if labeled.
noah: sampling decision: default sample 0.5%, auto-capture on error (>=500 or latency >8s), plus on-demand capture API. expose feature flag per-account to raise sampling.
irene: UX will include quick-link icons next to error groups to fetch a sampled trace. full-fetch will be behind a button with progress state.
david: routing for cost needs `x-route-id` to be precise. we'll ship heuristics initially using path+model mapping; later enable exact accounting when header adopted.
priya: customers need a migration doc and an opt-in plan for exact billing. I'll coordinate pilots.
noah: launch gates proposal:
- Overview dashboard: top-10 routes by cost & errors visible, panel render <2s P95
- Tracing: sampled quick-links + on-demand capture API implemented
- Cost: heuristic per-route estimates with confidence band; exact when `x-route-id` present and validated
- Errors: automatic grouping + top fingerprints
- Alerts: simple threshold alerting + webhook/email notifications
- Security: visibility data restricted to account admins; audit logs on access
- Docs: migration + pilot runbook validated by 2 customers
- SLOs: ingestion lag <6m P95, backfill <48h for recent window
david: I'll own canary + perf metrics (ETA Tue). will add feature.visibility.sampling_rate and sampling_override flags. ops-bot: canary scheduled: visibility:v0.3 -> 2134567920 (owner: david)
irene: I'll deliver mock and the estimate badge copy by Mon.
priya: I'll line up two pilots and draft comms by next Wed.
noah: final decision: ship heuristics day 0, sampling defaults as above, 48h retention, and RBAC for visibility. finance signoff required for retention delta. thumbs?
david: +1.
irene: +1.
priya: +1, pending pilot confirmations.
noah: done. I'll create the launch checklist and gating PR. Thanks. :rocket:
